name: Quality Harvest Foods Corp.
old_description: Discover the innovation and quality that make us a trusted partner in the baking industry.
about:
Quality Harvest Foods Corp. was established in 1964 in Portland, Oregon, when it introduced pita bread to the U.S. market. The company operates from a 150,000-square-foot facility in Portland's industrial hub, strategically located near Portland International Airport and Interstates 84 and 205.

As a contract manufacturer, Quality Harvest Foods produces individually frozen, fully finished sweet and savory bakery items such as filled sticks, bites, handhelds, and pull-aparts, along with pizza crusts. Its two production lines handle dough preparation, filling (including dual-filling capability), baking, and advanced packaging—individually wrapped oven/microwave-safe items, multi-packs, resealable stand-up pouches, and bulk formats. The facility employs approximately 270 people and runs 24-hour production.

The company serves leading food manufacturers, retail brands, foodservice operators, and K‑12 school nutrition programs. Its national account manager for K‑12 indicates a focus on the education segment, while its custom bakery solutions cater to brands seeking proprietary formulations and co‑packed products.

Quality Harvest Foods differentiates itself through an allergen‑limited facility (milk and wheat only), BRCGS Food Safety Certification with an A+ rating (2023) and A rating (2024), and a zero‑recall history. In‑house R&D develops proprietary dough flavors and fillings, and the company uses RedZone manufacturing software for real‑time production monitoring.
